priya: quick q — legal asked for an audit export for a customer incident. do our audit logs include function call arguments and which KMS key was used for the change? also what retention window applies if they ask for ‘last 3 years’. cc @mike @jess
mike: tl;dr: we DON'T log full function args by default (we redact large/blobs). we do log metadata + resource ids + event_type + actor + iam_role. kms key id is included for key-management events and certain crypto ops, but not for every object write.
alex: adding detail: use the readonly view `audit_events_v2` — columns: event_id, ts, actor, event_type, resource, meta (json). `meta` can contain `kms_key` or `arg_summary` when present.
alex: sample export query (psql COPY to s3 via aws cli):
```sql
COPY (
  SELECT event_id, ts, actor, event_type, resource, meta->>'kms_key' AS kms_key, meta->>'arg_summary' AS arg_summary
  FROM audit_events_v2
  WHERE ts >= '2023-01-01' AND ts < '2024-01-01'
) TO PROGRAM 'aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-exports/legal/2023-audit.csv' WITH CSV HEADER;
```
priya: perfect — thanks. do we need approvals to run ad-hoc exports to S3? and who signs off on PII redaction?
mike: yes — exports that may contain PII require an approval from `security-approvers` group + legal sign-off. for infra/ops exports we also need a ticket in #security-requests that references the runbook ID. @jess usually does infra approvals.
jess: I can approve infra exports if the ticket includes: (1) exact query, (2) redaction regex, (3) retention justification. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: export-job-123 queued by priya — status: awaiting-approval (requested approver: jess)
priya: thanks — i'll open the ticket now and attach the query + proposed redaction regex (we'll strip emails and long arg blobs). ETA ~30m.
mike: note on retention: primary audit_events retention = 3y. however ad-hoc S3 exports are stored with a default lifecycle of 7d unless the ticket explicitly requests longer retention for legal hold. put retention request in the ticket.
priya: ack, tagging @legal-team to confirm whether they need >7d
legal-team: noted, we'll confirm retention window and whether kms_key presence is required. if they need full key linkage we may escalate to infra for a targeted export.
priya: thanks all, filing ticket now.
